author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
why: Scientific caption identifies a colorized TEM of red rabies virions heavily infecting green cultured hamster kidney cells—not blood cells, despite the generic page title. Captured and color-enhanced at NIAID’s Integrated Research Facility. Vivid complementary colours suit a full-bleed card; direct image URL requests 3000 px width.

author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
why: Caption identifies a colorized TEM of rabies virus particles in orange, captured at NIAID’s Integrated Research Facility, Fort Detrick. Strong particle-to-background contrast makes this the first choice for a tight 9:10 crop. Direct image URL requests 3000 px width.
